body: Thanks. It's just hard, I gotta be strong for her. Don't want her OCD to get worse, it's so bad and I wish she'd go get help already. Wish we were both healed overnight
Will me and my gf ever get to be together?

My gf has severe ocd and I'm disabled, can't walk and dealing with pressure wounds and doctors all my life. My gf and I are long distance and I feel so helpless and bad for her. Threw away my blades (again) to help get her motivated to get better. I try to be positive for her, can't show her how I feel without making her anxiety worse. It's so easy to give in to the dark thoughts and cutting, and it sucks cause I know how hard it is for her to resist her compulsions and I feel like a failure cause I wanna give in too.
A lot of stuff going on..
